 Advertisement Updated: 5:32 PM EDT Oct 16, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jennifer Osting Air Canada to launch nonstop international flight out of Louisville next year
 Updated: 5:32 PM EDT Oct 16, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Jennifer Osting LOUISVILLE, Ky. — Louisville Muhammad Ali International Airport will add a new international flight route next spring, giving travelers more options for trips abroad.
 Air Canada announced Friday that nonstop flights between Louisville and Toronto will begin April 28, 2027.
 Advertisement The seasonal service will connect Louisville travelers to the Toronto Pearson International Airport.
 Officials say the new route is expected to improve travel options for the region while making it easier for Canadian visitors to travel to Louisville.
 "We've waited decades to have a regular international flight from a major carrier and some thought it would never happen, but today’s announcement by Air Canada shows confidence in our city's growth and momentum," said Louisville Mayor Craig Greenberg.
 The new route will not be offered year-round.
 Instead, it will be offered as a seasonal summer service that will run from late April through the end of October.
 The service is part of ongoing efforts to expand flight options at Louisville's airport and strengthen connections to international destinations.
 Tickets for the new flights are on sale now on Air Canada's website.
